title: Length of Review Period for Households on ComCare Short-to-Medium-Term Assistance Programmes
what_it_is: Length of Review Period for Households on ComCare Short-to-Medium-Term Assistance Programmes

sections.label: ComCare processing and support duration
sections.summary: No distinction is made between short-term and medium-term assistance; over nine in 10 ComCare applications are processed within four weeks, with approvals typically lasting three to six months and renewable.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: In terms of both the processing time and duration of approved support, we make no distinction between what may be considered short-term or medium-term assistance.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: More than nine out of 10 ComCare applications, including renewal applications, have been processed within four weeks, once the necessary documents have been submitted by applicants.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Approved applications are typically for periods of about three to six months and are renewable on further application.

sections.label: Renewal documents and online applications
sections.summary: For renewals, only documentation reflecting changes is needed, and both renewal and first applications can now be made online on the SupportGoWhere portal.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: In terms of documents submission, we are not expecting the family to come back with the full suite of documentation that was needed at first application.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: In fact, we will only need documentation that reflects the changes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: In terms of making sure that there is as little bandwidth tax on them as possible for the renewal process, the Member would be happy to note that now, applications for renewal as well as first applications can be made online on the SupportGoWhere portal.
